text: From S4.5x (plot API, s45x-plot-api f5be61be): (1) beeswarm ±7 px offset is device px while mark anchors are data coords — add a device-px offset on PlotMark/PlotTarget so rings and cursor follow the swarm. (2) Histogram fallback: bar height is a row count computed in studio. Decide in this ticket whether that is presentation (acceptable) or the backend should serve bin rows; the 'no science in studio' rule leans to backend-served bins if the bins carry any analytic meaning.
